title: Cbt Metric3 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: SimplePractice therapy sessions (`simplepractice:session`), Headway appointments (`headway:appointment`), BetterHelp sessions (`betterhelp:session`), CBT homework logs (`cbt:homework`), and Daylio mood entries (`daylio:mood`).
app: SimplePractice session notes, Headway appointment confirmations, BetterHelp messaging sessions, CBT homework trackers, and Daylio mood exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cbt:metric3
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for cbt metric3 (3) data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate cbt metric3 (3) events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It follows how your cbt metric3 (3) activity added up each month instead of day by day.
